reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: checkColumnResponse (L176-194) validates only inclusion proof (L190), not array lengths. Columns are inserted into quarantine (L437) without KZG verification. Block processor calls verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs (L687), which constructs cellIndices matching column.len (L391-393) but never validates kzg_commitments.len == kzg_proofs.len before calling verifyCellKzgProofBatch (L395-397). The 01e spec (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json, L78-93) explicitly requires: 'len(comms) == len(indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs)' before batch verification. This is a clear spec deviation. When mismatched arrays reach the C library, undefined behavior (out-of-bounds access) is plausible. Severity calibrated to Medium: single P2P packet can trigger the issue, affecting Nimbus nodes (estimated >5% network share under Fusaka diversity assumptions).
